title: Hide me now
lyrics_original: Hide me now
Under Your wings
Cover me
Within Your mighty hand
When the oceans rise and thunders roar
I will soar with you above the storm
Father, You are King over the flood
I will be still and know You are God
Find rest my soul
In Christ alone
Know His power
In quietness and trust
When the oceans rise and thunders roar
I will soar with you above the storm
Father, You are King over the flood
I will be still and know You are God
Your Joy Oh lord
will be my strength,
Renouncing fear
We stand in your glorious grace.
When the oceans rise and thunders roar
I will soar with you above the storm
Father, You are King over the flood
I will be still and know You are God

bible_verses.telugu: ఆయన తన రెక్కలతో నిన్ను కప్పును ఆయన రెక్కల క్రింద నీకు ఆశ్రయము కలుగును ఆయన సత్యము, కేడెమును డాలునై యున్నది.
bible_verses.english: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.

bible_verses.telugu: ఊరకుండుడి నేనే దేవుడనని తెలిసికొనుడి అన్యజనులలో నేను మహోన్నతుడ నగుదును భూమిమీద నేను మహోన్నతుడ నగుదును
bible_verses.english: He says, "Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth."

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా ప్రళయజలములమీద ఆసీనుడాయెను యెహోవా నిత్యము రాజుగా ఆసీనుడైయున్నాడు.
bible_verses.english: The Lord sits enthroned over the flood; the Lord is enthroned as King forever.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, when the storms of life feel overwhelming, thank You for being my safe hideaway and strong shelter. Cover me with Your grace and teach my anxious heart to be still in Your presence. I declare that You are King over every flood I face, and my soul chooses to find its complete rest in Christ alone. Lift me above my fears today so I may soar with You in peace. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, when the storms of life feel overwhelming, thank You for being my safe hideaway and strong shelter. Cover me with Your grace and teach my anxious heart to be still in Your presence. I declare that You are King over every flood I face, and my soul chooses to find its complete rest in Christ alone. Lift me above my fears today so I may soar with You in peace. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Life often brings overwhelming storms, but we are never called to face the crashing waves in our own strength. When the thunders roar, God invites us to draw near and hide beneath the shadow of His wings, resting in the truth that He reigns supreme over every flood. As we surrender our fears, our souls find quiet confidence in Christ alone. Let this song be your gentle reminder to be still, trusting that the King who commands the winds is holding you securely today.
